reason: A DSH plugin that embeds a workspace file tree and text or Markdown preview panel in the GUI, with documented workspace-bound file listing and reading.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 图形界面中提供工作区文件树、文本文件预览和 Markdown 渲染面板。
summaries.en: Provides a DSH GUI panel for browsing workspace files and previewing text and Markdown content.

capabilities: Lists files and directories in the current session workspace
Reads and previews text files within the workspace
Renders Markdown and applies syntax highlighting in an embedded browser panel
Registers host API routes and client-side interface slots
